prompt: Implement the attached organization-wide Docker base image management brief; support Debian 11 bullseye, Debian 12 bookworm, Debian 13 trixie, Ubuntu 20.04 through 26.04 major LTS releases, opinionated framework images, GitHub Actions publishing, the latest four Alpine and BusyBox versions, a dropdown image selector, and automatic date/time tags.
response: Added Debian, Ubuntu, React, Vite, Alpine 3.21-3.24, BusyBox 1.36.0-1.38.0, and GitHub Actions Runner 2.329.0 on Ubuntu 24.04 catalog entries plus Dockerfiles, lifecycle metadata, support-matrix entries, and exactly three user-facing GHCR workflows: Publish base image, Publish runtime image, and Publish framework image. Documented services as ready-to-run infrastructure such as web servers, databases, brokers, proxies, observability components, and self-hosted Actions runners.
